title: rbac-v2: enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 so that KMS-backed keys and data residency constraints are enforced at policy evaluation time and augment audit logs with KMS key identity and region pinning decisions. This resolves ENG-5210 and addresses recent compliance asks for region residency proofs. Summary of changes: 1) Policy engine: new constraint 'kms_region_pin' on Resource and Principal policy types; evaluation short-circuits when a request violates pinning rules; 2) Audit subsystem: include kms_key_id, kms_key_region, policy_evaluation_reason and policy_matched_rule in structured audit events; 3) API: add validation to write/update RBAC policies via API to prevent invalid region pin patterns; 4) Migrations: data migration to annotate existing keys with inferred region tags where available and backfill audit schema; 5) Tests & docs: unit/integration tests and docs for operators on how to author region-pin policies and how to interpret audit events. Rollout plan: feature-flagged behind security.rbac_v2.kms_region_pin; staged rollout to production infra with canary in us-west-2 then global; migration runs in read-only batches; immediate monitoring dashboards created to catch false positives. Related: Linear ENG-5210, SEC-1023; SUP-4412 (customer support case).
commit_summary: Add kms_region_pin enforcement to policy evaluator and matcher
Augment audit events with kms_key_id, kms_key_region, policy_matched_rule, policy_evaluation_reason
API validation for policy create/update and admin UI warnings
Migration to backfill key region tags and audit event schema change
Unit and integration tests for edge cases (multi-key, cross-region fallback)

tests_run: e2e: console policy editor warning + API validation
migration_steps: 1) Run dry-run backfill to estimate failures; 2) Run batched background backfill to annotate kms_key_region on keys; 3) Apply audit schema change (adds fields with defaults); 4) Enable feature flag in canary region; 5) Monitor policy_evaluation_denied_count and audit anomalies; 6) Gradual global rollout
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 policies and enrich audit logs with KMS key identity and evaluation reasons. Administrators can now author 'kms_region_pin' constraints to require keys to live in a specific region. Migration required to backfill key region metadata. See docs/rbac/kms-region-pinning.md for operator guidance.
security_impact: Positive: enforces region residency and surfaces key identity in audit trails which helps compliance. Risk: the migration/backfill may cause policy denials if existing keys lack region metadata; mitigated by dry-run and staged rollout behind a feature flag.
observability_notes: Added metric policy_evaluation_denied_count, audit event fields (kms_key_id,kms_key_region,policy_matched_rule,policy_evaluation_reason), and a Grafana dashboard for canary monitoring. Alerts: >0.5% denied rate over 5m during canary triggers rollback.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag: security.rbac_v2.kms_region_pin. Migration job: migrations/2026_02_20_backfill_kms_region_tags.sql and background worker services/rbac-v2/migrator. Pre-check: run dry-run and inspect missing region tag report. If migration failure rate >5% pause and escalate to security-team.
